title: Firmware Engineer
description:
Role: Firmware Engineer

Location : NYC

Overview

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and debug firmware for a wide range of client EMG devices, ensuring high performance and reliability.
  • Build interactive data collection applications using JavaScript frameworks for EMG device characterization and study protocol execution.
  • Conduct in-depth firmware debugging and hands-on failure analysis (FA) on client hardware, identifying root causes of issues at the intersection of hardware and firmware.
  • Develop and execute FA/QA test plans for new hardware and firmware releases, including regression, stress, and edge-case testing.
  • Collaborate closely with the Hardware, Software, and Data Foundations teams to integrate firmware updates, improvements, and fixes based on FA/QA findings.
  • Implement power management, boot loaders, scheduling, and inter-processor communication on Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) or bare-metal environments.
  • Inspect prototype hardware and determine the cause of failures during early phases of development using advanced debugging techniques and tools (e.g., oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG).
  • Review data sheets of new hardware components and develop scripts to analyze failures, resolve open-ended problems, and support rapid prototyping.
  • Review failure reports of failing hardware or firmware, inspect units, and determine root causes using systematic debugging and analysis.
  • Write low-level software and scripting language code (Python preferred) to develop tools for failure analysis, system validation, and hardware development support.
  • Collaborate with silicon architects, hardware designers, OS, and algorithm development teams to resolve complex cross-domain issues.
  • Develop and automate manufacturing tests to ensure the quality and reliability of Client EMG products.
  • Effectively communicate findings, progress, and challenges to stakeholders, manufacturers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Investigate and analyze parts and devices received from the field and manufacturing partners to establish root causes of issues and recommend corrective actions.
  • Prepare and present detailed FA/QA reports with findings for each lot of parts or assemblies, including recommendations for design or process improvements.
  • Track failure trends, maintain FA/QA documentation, and provide insights for continuous improvement of Client EMG hardware and firmware.
  • Stay current with industry best practices in firmware debugging, failure analysis, and QA methodologies, and drive adoption within the team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in embedded software/firmware development, debugging, and failure analysis.
  • JavaScript/Web development experience for interactive study protocol development and web application frameworks.
  • Proficiency in C/C++ for firmware design, programming, debugging, and testing.
  • Strong knowledge of hardware, clock-level issues, interrupts, polling, and hands-on debugging tools (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, JTAG, etc.).
  • Experience in scripting languages, with expertise in Python preferred, for automation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with peripherals such as UART, SPI, CSI-2, I2C, GPIO, USB is desirable.
  • Familiarity with wireless and wired communication protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, Ethernet, Bluetooth, 802.11) is a plus.
  • Experience developing and executing FA/QA test plans for hardware and firmware.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple teams and foster seamless cooperation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, a proactive problem-solving attitude, and attention to detail.

title: Program Manager
description:
Title: Program Manager
Location: San Jose, CA - (Onsite from day1 Local Only)
Duration: 6-12+ months contract

Job Description:
We are seeking a Program Manager to join our Firmware Test Engineering (FTE) team in San Jose, CA. In this mid-level role, you will play a crucial part in translating the FTE team’s strategic objectives into actionable program plans that deliver measurable quality and efficiency improvements. You will lead cross-functional initiatives and coordinate stakeholders across firmware development, hardware, quality, and product teams to ensure our firmware testing efforts are aligned with product release goals. This role has a broad scope of impact – you will drive data-driven program management practices, leverage analytics and automation to optimize test processes, and guide a team of engineers toward successful firmware validation outcomes. Your work will directly influence the reliability of our products and the speed at which we deliver innovations to customers.
Key Responsibilities
• Program Leadership & Planning: Own and manage multiple concurrent firmware test projects, developing program roadmaps and setting testing strategies aligned with product milestones. Define clear program goals and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and ensure on-time delivery of testing deliverables in line with overall business objectives.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the primary liaison between Firmware Test Engineering and other groups (firmware development, hardware engineering, product management, etc.) to manage interdependencies and ensure seamless integration of testing into the product development lifecycle. Build positive relationships with all stakeholders to drive alignment and successful program execution.
• Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular updates on project/program status, including progress against schedule, risk assessment, and issue tracking. Facilitate program reviews and cross-functional meetings to drive decision-making, address risks, and keep everyone engaged and informed of key developments.
• Data-Driven Decision Making: Establish methods for measuring and monitoring test program performance (e.g. test coverage, defect escape rates, cycle time). Utilize data analytics and visualization (e.g. developing dashboards in Power BI) to track these metrics and extract actionable insights. Leverage data to identify trends and continuously improve test effectiveness and efficiency.
• Issue Resolution & Risk Management: Proactively identify potential risks, bottlenecks, or quality issues in the testing process. Serve as a front-line liaison for triaging problems – coordinating with engineering leads to resolve firmware bugs, test failures, and resource constraints promptly. Implement risk mitigation plans and contingency strategies to keep programs on track.
• Process Optimization & Innovation: Drive ongoing improvements in test processes and workflows. Leverage prior experience and lessons learned to optimize and standardize testing methodologies. Champion the introduction of new tools or techniques – for example, applying AI/ML-driven analytics for smarter test selection or using Python automation to reduce manual effort – to increase the speed and quality of firmware validation.
• Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a program team of test engineers and project leads, even in a matrixed environment. Set clear priorities, influence without direct authority, and foster a collaborative team culture. By “leading through influence,” ensure that team members across different sites and departments remain motivated, adopt necessary process changes, and work together toward program objectives

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. 5+ years of experience in program management or project leadership within a technology environment (preferably involving software/firmware development or testing). Demonstrated success managing complex projects or programs with cross-functional teams.
• Technical Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of the software/firmware development life cycle and software testing processes. Familiarity with embedded systems or firmware for hardware devices is highly beneficial for context in this role.
• Project Management Skills: Proven expertise in both Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies. Able to plan sprints or project phases, run Scrum ceremonies or schedule reviews, and adapt process as needed. Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools – especially JIRA for issue/task tracking and Confluence or similar for documentation – is required.
• Data Analytics & Reporting: Strong data analysis skills and a metrics-driven approach to management. Able to define meaningful metrics for program success, and comfortable analyzing large data sets (e.g. test results, defect trends) to derive insights. Experience creating reports or dashboards using Power BI (or similar BI/analytics tools) to communicate status and support decision-making is required.
• Programming/Scripting: Hands-on ability with Python programming for automation or data processing tasks. You should be capable of writing or understanding scripts to automate test processes or to manipulate and analyze test data. (Direct firmware coding experience is not required, but the ability to engage with engineers on technical details and contribute to tooling via scripts is important.)
• AI/ML Familiarity: Knowledge of basic machine learning concepts and AI tools in a data analytics context. The ideal candidate can work with data scientists or engineers to apply AI/ML techniques for predicting failures, optimizing test coverage, or other process improvements. Experience leveraging AI/ML for real-world engineering or quality analytics is a strong plus.
• Soft Skills: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills are a must. Able to clearly convey complex information (e.g. technical issues, data insights, program status) to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong organizational and leadership capabilities, including the ability to lead through influence and keep teams focused on shared goals. Demonstrated problem-solving aptitude and a proactive, ownership-driven attitude toward overcoming challenges.
• Teamwork: A track record of effective collaboration in cross-functional and multi-cultural/global teams. Ability to work across time zones and adapt to work with team members in different geographic locations. High degree of flexibility and cultural awareness in coordinating a global test effort.

title: Sr. HTML Specialist
description:
Job Title: Sr. HTML Specialist

Location: New York City, NY – Hybrid Role

 

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for a senior front-end design technologist who specializes in one of the most demanding forms of digital craftsmanship: HTML email development. This full-time, U.S.-based contract role is for someone who is not only deeply familiar with the quirks and constraints of email clients but finds joy in outsmarting them—building layouts that look beautiful and perform flawlessly across desktop, mobile, and tablet in both light and dark modes.

You’ll join the global technology team within client, reporting to the Head of UX & Creative and partnering closely with design, content, and technology leads. Your work will bring our internal campaigns and communications to life at scale, supporting sophisticated enterprise needs with the speed and reliability they demand.

It's very, very important that this person be more than just a front-end generalist (although those are good secondary skills)... they must have strong experience working at enterprise-scale specifically with HTML email templates, preferably in a B2C marketing team or similar, and be interested in continuing in that work. Folks with pedigrees at notable B2C tech firms/unicorns are of particular interest.

What We’re Looking For

We need an expert email developer who thrives on precision, consistency, and the challenge of building in a medium most developers avoid. You’re on target if you:

  • Have 5–7+ years of experience coding HTML/CSS emails at scale for large organizations or enterprises, with a portfolio to prove it
  • Are deeply fluent in the nuances of email development: nested tables, inline styles, VML for Outlook, responsive/adaptive layouts using email client-compatible media queries, and dark mode/light mode considerations
  • Stay up to date on the very latest email client and rendering engine compatibility (e.g., Microsoft Word rendering in Outlook, Gmail, WebKit for Apple Mail, etc.), and the effective tricks of the trade to achieve consistently elevated, bulletproof deliverables across complex templates
  • Know how to collaborate with designers and translate Figma designs into exacting, functional code
  • Can write clean, well-commented markup that others can extend or troubleshoot quickly under time crunch
  • Familiarity and an eye for detail with accessibility best practices in email (e.g.: semantic markup, alt text)
  • Take pride in testing rigor. Litmus and similar platforms are second nature to you.
  • Have experience working within Pardot, Storyports, or similar WYSIWYG campaign builders (bonus points if you’ve built modular, reusable components in these tools)
  • Are comfortable working fast when priorities shift without sacrificing quality or reliability

You Might Be a Fit If You...

  • Find the quirks of email clients more fun than frustrating—building elegant code that works everywhere is a puzzle you enjoy solving
  • Get satisfaction from seeing your work scaled across thousands of sends, with every detail intact
  • Appreciate design craft and understand that typography, spacing, and hierarchy matter as much in an inbox as they do on the web
  • Have the temperament of both a perfectionist and a pragmatist—you sweat the details but know when to ship

title: Salesforce Admin
description:
User Management. This goes beyond just setting up a user and providing access. The Salesforce Admin serves as a subject matter expert for user and team needs. They design a Salesforce solution that is customized and ensures a good user experience. Behind this is the goal to improve productivity and increase adoption. Data Management. Putting the right fields in a record and ensuring all the right information is being captured is just a start. Salesforce Admins use their expertise to ensure the data is high quality (no duplications), that the data can be reported on for key business decisions, and that users get the information they need easily. Security. The Salesforce Admin collaborates with your company's IT and security teams to ensure the Salesforce solution aligns with compliance needs and policies. Just as users need to trust that the data is accurate, the company needs to trust that the data is also secure. The admin ensures Salesforce is configured so that users see only what they need to see. Actionable Analytics. Salesforce helps to make building reports simple and straightforward. The Salesforce Admin takes it a step further by ensuring the reports and dashboards built for their company are easy to read and that users can make critical decisions based on the information they're seeing. They help ensure the analytics are aligned with the company's goals. Product Management. This responsibility centers on managing Salesforce like a product, continuing to build on the platform, deliver new features to users, and drive a healthy environment. A big part of this is preparing users for Salesforce Releases and proactively looking for ways to expand Salesforce functionality across your organization. description:
Job Title: Appian Business Analyst

Location: Jersey City, NJ - Hybrid

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Appian Business Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will be the vital link between our business stakeholders and the technical development team, using your expertise to translate business needs into robust, low-code solutions on the Appian platform. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of business process management (BPM), excellent communication skills, and a proven ability to drive digital transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Requirements Gathering and Analysis: Work closely with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, and end-users to elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements for Appian applications and workflows.

  • Solution Design: Translate business requirements into technical specifications for the Appian development team. Assist in designing the user experience, process models, data structures (CDTs), user interfaces (SAIL), and business rules.

  • Testing and Validation: Coordinate and execute functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure the final Appian solution meets all business requirements and functions as intended.
  • Documentation and Training: Develop and maintain comprehensive project documentation, user guides, and training materials. Conduct training sessions for end-users on new Appian features and applications.
  • Integration and Technology: Understand how Appian can be integrated with other systems and work with technical teams to define integration requirements involving APIs and connected systems.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience as a business analyst
  • Proven experience gathering, documenting, and refining business and technical requirements for Appian-based systems.
  • Solid knowledge of Appian components, including Process Models, SAIL interfaces, Custom Data Types (CDTs), Records, Reports, and Security.
